specs.name: fleet.status
specs.description: Read the fleet host status (integrity, lanes gate, policy selftest flag, board head, MCP listener/sessions/log) plus this facade's own counters. Read-only. No secrets.

specs.name: session.create
specs.description: Create a REAL DSH agent session on the deterministic stub route ("deterministic-stub (fleet-selftest-stub)"): model-free, labelled, no provider credential. Optional role preset (lead/builder/checker/researcher) and optional first prompt. Prompts run as real turns through llm/stream and the fleet budget gate; each result names its transport (agent | stub-turn). mode:"model" is staged and refused with model-credential-not-entered until the owner enters a provider key — no model call is ever faked.

preset.description: role preset: lead, builder, checker, researcher (or fleet-<role>)

prompt.description: optional first prompt text, run as one stub turn

mode.description: stub (default, deterministic) or model (staged: currently refused)

specs.name: session.prompt
specs.description: Run ONE real agent turn on an existing stub-route session and return the assistant text (deterministic: the stub answers "S3STUB:<your text>"), plus `transport`: "agent" when fleet-ledger's gate allows a direct turn on the session, or "stub-turn" when the ledger reserves synthetic provider calls for selftest principals — then `turn_agent` names the selftest principal and `ledger_gate` says why (stub-provider-selftest-only). Nothing is faked: the stub-turn transport is the fleet's own one-real-turn op through the same gate.

specs.name: session.status
specs.description: Report what the facade holds for a session (preset, model label, busy, turns, inbox, last assistant text). An unknown id answers found:false rather than an error.

specs.name: board.op
specs.description: Run ONE allowlisted board operation: a control-plane op (order-create, order-get, order-list, board-get, order-cancel, posts, pull, ack, preflight-close, done-when-amend, goldfish-disposition, verdict-tier2, unblock, check-start, lease-expire, sweep-now, goldfish-report, stub-turn, ledger-get, usage-feed, lessons-get) or a board bot tool through the model-free selftest transport (order_claim, preflight_raise, task_decompose, task_claim, evidence_post, task_submit_built, verdict, report_file, task_block, task_fail, task_write_claim, freshness_check, task_escalate, order_block, order_fail, board_read, lesson_propose, lessons_read). Fields are top-level beside op. task_claim_start -> task_claim and task_claim_finish -> task_submit_built; task-cancel does not exist (use task_fail/task_block/unblock). Control ops act as the fleet owner principal; selftest tool calls act only on fixture orders.

op.description: the board op or board tool name

role.description: selftest transport role (default: the tool's normal role)

args.description: optional nested tool args (merged with the top-level fields)

specs.name: order.drive_roundtrip
specs.description: Run a REAL work-order lifecycle through the board rails, deterministically and model-free: order-create (fixture:true, the fidelity the fleet's own acceptance check uses) -> order_claim -> preflight -> task_decompose -> task_claim -> evidence_post -> task_submit_built -> check-start -> verdict pass -> lesson banking -> report_file -> wait for the harness finisher to read the done-when and roll the order up. Returns the id chain, posts and final state, labelled mode:"fixture-validated" and real_lane:"not-built (Stage 4 roster)" — it never claims a real lane drove it. Throws a named refusal when a step fails (and cancels a leftover fixture order).

done_when.description: the done-when: a shell command string, {mode:"command",command,text?}, or {mode:"rubric",criteria:[string]}

example.description: what good work looks like (order form example)

specs.name: order.stage_real
specs.description: Stage (do NOT execute) a real, non-fixture work order exactly as a Nox delegation would create it (title, goal, done_when, example, est_minutes, budget_usd, checkpoint_at). The validated payload is written under <statePath>/staged/ for later firing; the order row is created fixture:false ONLY when a Stage 4 roster is mounted. Today no roster exists, so it refuses cleanly with lanes-unavailable and returns the staged file path + payload digest.

goal.description: the goal the order exists to reach

done_when.description: the done-when: a shell command string, {mode:"command",command,text?}, or {mode:"rubric",criteria:[string]}

example.description: what good work looks like (order form example)

checkpoint_at.description: future epoch ms or ISO timestamp (default: now + 24h)

specs.name: fleet.selftest
specs.description: Run ONE board tool through the real ctx.tools pipeline inside a role's preset (the fleet's model-free selftest transport), exactly as the acceptance checks do. The tool is restricted to the board-tool allowlist — never shell/fs/web. Returns the tool result plus the DSH call_id and session.

role.description: the role whose preset the call runs in

tool.description: the board tool name (order_claim, task_decompose, task_claim, evidence_post, verdict, ...)

specs.name: actions.status
specs.description: Read the tail of the hash-chained MCP action log (<logPath>, default /var/lib/fleet/log/mcp-actions.jsonl): principal, tool, argument NAMES and sha256 digest (never values), outcome, and the chain head. Read-only.
